additional_info.subject: ID0424330-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S2 170003340] Loading Process CRM:02699000103
additional_info.body:
Hello Martin, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
I checked the logs for the whole night and I can see that the stopping should be coming from the HMI. Can you please confirm that no one touched it?
If no one touched it, then there might be a conflict in the SECC that is causing this session abortions.
First of all, I would like to restart the charger and see if it improves.
Second, I would recommend to always have the latest version due to improvements. Since we also have the wake-up function hotfix and since it's under testing we cannot exclude this.
Please let me know your feedback.
Thank you and have a nice day!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.body:
Hallo Francisco,
ab ca. 22Uhr bis ca. 3Uhr wird niemand an das SKID anfassen.
Ein Neustart steht nicht im Wege solange sie bis 16Uhr damit fertig sind.
Sie können gerne eine neue Version aufspielen, sollten aber ca.16Uhr damit fertig sein danach wird das SKID wieder benötigt.
